summary.text: Arthur Orr is a Republican member of the Alabama Senate for District 3, elected in November 2006.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative profile, he was born in 1964 in Decatur, earned a bachelor's degree from Wake Forest University and a J.D. from the University of Alabama School of Law, and is executive vice president at Cook's Pest Control.
The profile says he was a U.S. Peace Corps volunteer in Nepal and worked as a staff attorney for Habitat for Humanity International in the Asia/Pacific region.
